sample_selection.rule_description: one expression-complete eligible RNA-seq sample per TCGA participant; clinical filters and endpoint completeness are applied first, samples lacking the requested gene or complete signature score are removed second, and biospecimen priority is applied last. Primary tumor or primary blood-derived cancer samples are preferred, followed by recurrent/additional/metastatic tumor samples, then normal/control samples only when no higher-priority expression-complete sample remains; ties are resolved by RNA analyte/portion metadata and barcode.
